value.account:
CHANGED
- New orchestrator/workflow/resume_projection_integrity.py: ResumeScopePath, audit_scope, ResumeProjectionIntegrityError, diagnostic builder (twelve reasons, privacy-safe context). Lineage lives in call_frame_lineage.py (index_retry_lineage, next_unused_retry_frame_id, re-exported); loop bookkeeping validation in resume_loop_progress.py (ResumeProjectionValidationError, re-exported from state_projection).
- state_projection.py: enumerate_resume_slots / resolve_resume_step_id / resolve_call_boundary, slot/index/resolution dataclasses, CallBoundaryProjection.import_alias (lowering fills it). repeat_until maximums are held in a separate WorkflowStateProjection mapping (not on IterationStepKeyProjection) so characterization snapshots only gain import_alias; I regenerated the two goldens that contain call boundaries.
- StateManager.record_workflow_checksum_mismatch / record_resume_projection_integrity_failure edit the raw state.json so only status/error/updated_at change and unknown root fields survive.
- CLI resume: audit right after root-checksum acceptance (after the completed-run short circuit), before observability persistence, session/process metadata and executor construction; exit 1 + stderr reason + envelope only. Session close failure no longer replaces the result.
- WorkflowExecutor.execute: structural-root guard (not a CallFrameStateManager) rechecks checksum via state_manager.calculate_checksum (four reasons) then audits, before the prologue. _handle_control_flow stops on the sticky error (promoted unchanged to run error, ignoring routes/on_error), for_each stops before the next iteration, typed loop bodies stop immediately, finalization failures are supplemental (failure.error null for ordinary failures; projection error arising in finalization becomes the run error).
- CallExecutor.execute_call (resume): completed-frame-id collision check first, exactly one resolve_call_boundary per reached call, boundary alias selects the bundle, lineage-based frame selection (no mapping-order/name selection; frame_id_with_overrides lost its resume branch), then checksum -> bound inputs -> alias check -> failed predecessors (checksum + recursive audit_scope) -> running scope audit, before any child manager/executor. Projection failures become the call result and are passed through, never wrapped in call_failed. _is_workflow_lisp_target now means frontend_kind == 'workflow_lisp'.
- Loader: import_alias_audit.py composes the YAML node graph to report duplicate aliases / repeated top-level imports with line/column before bundle construction.
- Typed provenance: lowering/core.py stamps frontend_kind on every lowered bundle; build_frontend_bundle no longer overwrites it. Because that makes direct-compiled bundles look like Workflow Lisp, lexical_checkpoint_default_resume's route check now also requires frontend_build_root, preserving its old behaviour.
- Observability: forensic_step.current_step_is_forensic used by build_status_snapshot (step shows pending, no 'in progress'), monitor heartbeat/classifier and dashboard heartbeat.
- Docs: specs/state.md section and acceptance entries 201-208.
- Tests: new tests/test_resume_projection_integrity.py (48 tests); rewrote the characterization tests that pinned the old gaps (resume_command, subworkflow_calls) and adjusted tests whose premises the spec changes: hand-written current_step without step_id (now missing_required_identity) got step ids; CLI plumbing tests with stand-in bundles stub audit_scope; the adjudication changed-config test bypasses the new root checksum recheck on purpose; the repeat_until drift test now expects invalid_loop_progress. Full suite: 47 failed / 4770 passed; the 47 are exactly the failures present on a clean HEAD export (nanobragg, monitor help, tmux, neurips, post_wcc inventory etc.), none new.

ALTERNATIVES / DECISIONS
- Putting max_iterations on IterationStepKeyProjection was tried and dropped (changes serialized goldens beyond the spec'd import_alias).
- Auditing inside the completed-run early return was rejected so a completed run is never turned into failed.
- Absent loop-frame rows are tolerated for terminal repeat_until progress (existing restore tests deliberately pop them); a present non-conforming row fails.
- Lineage ordinals must be contiguous from 0 across lineage members (my reading of 'missing ordinal'); several-running and mixed bases are ambiguous; ambiguous explicit step ids (several candidates) report unknown_explicit_step_id with the real count (spec lists no dedicated reason).
- expected_owner.workflow_file is str(bundle.provenance.workflow_path); the scope root uses the state's recorded workflow_file.

NOT COVERED / RISKS
- No design doc (docs/design/...) or docs/index / capability-matrix routing updates; only specs/state.md and acceptance entries.
- Nested loops inside loops only checked on a smoke workflow; unusual qualified ids outside projection enumeration would fail closed.
- Hidden tests may disagree on judgment calls above (current_step.step_id strictness for legacy states, field names for some reasons, lineage gap rule).
- A ponytail-style cleanup of calls.py (still >500 lines, pre-existing) was not attempted.
- Nothing committed.
